item.text: {"action":"batch","arguments_json":"{\"calls\":[{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import copy, json\\nfrom work import evaluate\\ncases = [\\n ({'declared':['z','a','z'],'saved':{'a':{'kind':'file','meta':{'b':2,'a':1}},'z':[1,2]},'current':{'a':{'meta':{'a':1,'b':2},'kind':'file'},'z':[1,3]}},{},{'needs_review':True,'changed':['z']}),\\n ({'declared':['a','b'],'saved':{'a':None,'b':{'kind':'file','hash':'old'}},'current':{'a':None,'b':{'kind':'file','hash':'new'}}},{'ignored':['b','b']},{'needs_review':False,'changed':[]}),\\n ({'declared':['gone'],'saved':{'gone':{'kind':'missing'}},'current':{}},{},{'needs_review':False,'changed':[]}),\\n ({'declared':['x'],'saved':{'x':{'kind':'file','parts':[1,2]}},'current':{'x':{'kind':'file','parts':[2,1]}}},{},{'needs_review':True,'changed':['x']})\\n]\\nfor request, policy, expected in cases:\\n    request_before, policy_before = copy.deepcopy(request), copy.deepcopy(policy)\\n    actual = evaluate(request, policy)\\n    assert actual == expected, (actual, expected)\\n    assert request == request_before and policy == policy_before\\nprint('independent boundary cases passed:', len(cases))\"]}},{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import json\\nfrom work import evaluate\\nwith open('requests.json', encoding='utf-8') as f: requests=json.load(f)\\nwith open('policy.json', encoding='utf-8') as f: policy=json.load(f)\\nexpected=[evaluate(request, policy) for request in requests]\\nwith open('report.json', encoding='utf-8') as f: actual=json.load(f)\\nassert actual == expected, (actual, expected)\\nprint('report verified:', json.dumps(actual, sort_keys=True))\"]}},{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"git\",\"status\",\"--short\"]}}]}"}
